taiwan_aviation.headline: 波蘭通報俄羅斯無人機短暫進入領空 北約準備增派空中預警機支援波蘭
taiwan_aviation.summary: 波蘭軍方表示，11月23日晚間一架俄羅斯無人機短暫進入波蘭領空，當時俄羅斯正攻擊烏克蘭西部。副國防部長帕韋烏・扎萊夫斯基認為此舉是蓄意行為；近期一連串領空事件後，北約準備增派空中預警機支援波蘭。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Poland reports brief Russian drone incursion; NATO prepares additional early warning aircraft
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Poland’s military said a Russian drone briefly entered Polish airspace on the evening of November 23 while Russia was attacking western Ukraine. Deputy Defence Minister Paweł Zalewski said he believed the incursion was deliberate. Following a series of recent airspace incidents, NATO is preparing additional airborne early warning aircraft to support Poland.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 美國聯邦航空總署因航管人力不足一度暫停部分飛往奧黑爾機場的航班起飛 GE Aerospace 國防部門執行長將於2027年離任 工程副總裁將立即代理
taiwan_aviation.summary: 芝加哥近場航管人力不足，美國聯邦航空總署11月23日一度要求部分飛往奧黑爾國際機場的航班留在出發地，中午解除限制。GE Aerospace 國防部門執行長將於2027年首季離任，工程副總裁將立即代理。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: FAA briefly holds some O’Hare-bound flights over staffing; GE Aerospace defense chief to leave in 2027; engineering vice president to act immediately
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Due to staffing shortages at Chicago’s approach control, the Federal Aviation Administration held some O’Hare-bound flights at their departure airports on November 23 and lifted the restriction around noon. GE Aerospace’s defense chief will leave in the first quarter of 2027, and the engineering vice president will immediately serve as interim chief executive.

international_aviation.headline: 高雄國際機場氣候韌性案例納入報告 在聯合國氣候大會發表
international_aviation.summary: 民航局表示，高雄國際機場的氣候韌性案例獲國際永續基礎設施聯盟收錄於報告，並在聯合國氣候大會發表。機場強化排水滯洪及防水抗風工程，2024年強颱期間航廈與跑道未淹水。防災體系另獲國際機場協會亞太及中東地區氣候變遷調適白金獎。
international_aviation.headline_en: Kaohsiung International Airport resilience case included in report and presented at UN climate conference
international_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration said Kaohsiung International Airport’s climate resilience case was included in an International Coalition for Sustainable Infrastructure report and presented at a UN climate conference. Measures include strengthened drainage, flood retention, waterproofing and wind-resistant works. The terminal and runway did not flood during a strong typhoon in 2024. The airport’s disaster response system also received an Airports Council International platinum award for climate change adaptation in the Asia-Pacific and Middle East region.

international_aviation.headline: 以色列交通部長同意 flydubai 恢復杜拜至特拉維夫航班 仍待安全機關核准
international_aviation.summary: 以色列交通部長同意 flydubai 恢復杜拜至特拉維夫航班，但復飛仍須取得以色列安全機關核准，日期尚未公布。航空公司正與有關機關協調；flydubai 曾在9月30日一班飛往特拉維夫的航班因機上安全事件轉降後暫停該航線。
international_aviation.headline_en: Israel’s transport minister agrees to flydubai’s Dubai–Tel Aviv return, pending security clearance
international_aviation.summary_en: Israel’s transport minister has agreed to flydubai resuming flights from Dubai to Tel Aviv, subject to clearance by Israeli security authorities. No restart date has been announced, and the airline is coordinating with the authorities. It suspended the route after a Tel Aviv-bound flight diverted on September 30 following an onboard security incident.

international_aviation.headline: 岡山桃太郎機場演練降落事故救援 愛爾蘭航空將改裝10架 A330 並首次引進豪華經濟艙 Schiebel 與 Osiris Poland 完成 Camcopter S-100 搭載小型無人機概念驗證
international_aviation.summary: 岡山桃太郎機場11月24日模擬客機降落事故，演練傷患救援、檢傷分類及初期應變。愛爾蘭航空計畫改裝10架空中巴士 A330，首次引進豪華經濟艙，首架改裝客機預計自2027年10月1日起執飛部分都柏林至紐約甘迺迪機場航班。Schiebel 與 Osiris Poland 在奧地利完成 Camcopter S-100 搭載小型無人機的概念驗證，屬展示試驗。
international_aviation.headline_en: Okayama Airport rehearses landing-accident response; Aer Lingus plans A330 premium-economy retrofit; Schiebel and Osiris Poland complete drone demonstration
international_aviation.summary_en: Okayama Momotaro Airport held a landing-accident exercise on November 24, rehearsing casualty rescue, triage and initial response. Aer Lingus plans to refurbish 10 Airbus A330s and introduce its first premium economy cabin. The first refurbished aircraft is scheduled to serve selected Dublin–New York JFK flights from October 1, 2027. Schiebel and Osiris Poland completed a proof-of-concept demonstration in Austria involving a Camcopter S-100 carrying a small drone.

international_aviation.headline: Schiebel 展示 Camcopter S-100 空中釋放小型無人機 廈門航空簽約購買50架波音737 MAX 8 俄羅斯軍機接近鬱陵島 南韓當局短暫發布避難警報
international_aviation.summary: Schiebel 在奧地利展示 Camcopter S-100 空中釋放小型無人機。中國南方航空11月24日公告，旗下廈門航空簽約購買50架波音737 MAX 8，目錄價合計約74億美元，預計2031至2034年分批交付，仍待中國主管機關及股東核准。南韓軍方表示，多架俄羅斯軍機11月24日進入南韓防空識別區並接近鬱陵島，當局要求島上居民就地避難，約三分鐘後解除警報。
international_aviation.headline_en: Schiebel demonstrates airborne drone release; Xiamen Airlines signs to buy 50 Boeing 737 MAX 8 aircraft; South Korea briefly issues Ulleung shelter alert
international_aviation.summary_en: Schiebel demonstrated the airborne release of a small drone from a Camcopter S-100 in Austria. China Southern Airlines said on November 24 that its subsidiary Xiamen Airlines had agreed to buy 50 Boeing 737 MAX 8 aircraft with a combined list price of about $7.4 billion. Deliveries are planned for 2031 to 2034, and the deal requires Chinese government and shareholder approval. South Korea’s military said several Russian military aircraft entered its air defence identification zone and approached Ulleung Island on November 24. Authorities told residents to shelter in place, lifting the alert about three minutes later.

new_information: Schiebel, in partnership with Osiris Poland, deployed a small unmanned air system from its Camcopter S-100.
The Camcopter S-100 proof-of-concept demonstration took place in Austria.
The deployed sUAS was an Osiris HSCD-1 high-speed camera drone.
Trial footage shows a single HSCD-1 dropping from a side mount on an uncrewed helicopter as the helicopter flies forward.
Schiebel said the small drone was operated after release through a communications link relayed via the S-100.
Schiebel and Osiris Poland say the demonstration points to a possible counter-drone role for the S-100 as an airborne mothership.

international_aviation.headline: 南韓空軍首架 Embraer C-390 Millennium 飛抵首爾空軍基地 預計12月正式交機
international_aviation.summary: 南韓空軍採購的首架 Embraer C-390 Millennium 運輸機11月23日飛抵城南市的首爾空軍基地，仍掛巴西測試註冊號 PT-ZNA，尚未正式交付。交機預計12月進行，其餘兩架預計2027年底前交付；南韓空軍與 Embraer 尚未發布相關消息。
international_aviation.headline_en: South Korea’s first Embraer C-390 Millennium reaches Seoul Air Base, handover expected in December
international_aviation.summary_en: The first Embraer C-390 Millennium purchased for the South Korean Air Force landed at Seoul Air Base in Seongnam on November 23, still carrying Brazilian test registration PT-ZNA. It has not yet been formally delivered; handover is expected in December and the other two aircraft are expected by the end of 2027. Neither the air force nor Embraer had yet announced the arrival.

international_aviation.headline: 美國東岸風暴預計增強北移 感恩節期間航班恐受影響
international_aviation.summary: 美國東岸沿海風暴預計11月25日在東南岸外海增強，並於感恩節期間北移，可能影響東岸航班。費城機場陣風可能達每小時65英里；紐約都會區的紐華克、甘迺迪及拉瓜迪亞機場預報有雨及接近每小時50英里的東風陣風，也可能出現低空風切。美國聯邦航空總署預估九天假期全美航班超過417,000架次。
international_aviation.headline_en: US East Coast storm expected to strengthen and move north, threatening Thanksgiving flights
international_aviation.summary_en: A coastal storm is forecast to strengthen off the southeastern US coast on November 25 and move north during Thanksgiving, potentially affecting East Coast flights. Gusts could reach 65 mph at Philadelphia International Airport, while rain and easterly gusts near 50 mph are forecast at Newark Liberty, John F. Kennedy and LaGuardia airports; low-level wind shear is also possible. The Federal Aviation Administration expects more than 417,000 flights nationwide over the nine-day Thanksgiving holiday period.
